_comment: Curated terse tool descriptions. These are SHORTER than the originals but deliberately KEEP the behavioural guidance (prerequisites, 'use X not Y', constraints) that a model needs to call the tool correctly. Point the adapter at this file with OVERRIDES=./overrides.example.json. Add an entry per tool you want compressed safely; tools without an entry keep their full description (lossless).
get_architecture: Return a Mermaid diagram from static analysis. scope=overview (dependency flowchart) or pages (class diagram). Return it verbatim.
get_test_conventions: The framework's test-writing rules: fixtures, page-object method catalog, tags, import header, template. Call this before generating any test.
list_page_objects: List all Page Object classes with their public methods + locators. Call before writing a test so you use methods that exist.
list_tests: List spec files with their describe blocks, titles and @tags. Use as examples of the framework's conventions.
retrieve_context: PREFERRED first step to understand the codebase. NL query -> a compact token-budgeted context pack: the most relevant AST-aware code/test/doc chunks, hybrid-ranked and de-duplicated, each cited 'file › symbol'. Use INSTEAD of reading whole files. Options: tokenBudget, kinds.
code_map: Signatures-only skeleton of the framework (classes + public methods, exported functions/consts, per file). Cheap breadth when you need the shape, not the source. Optional 'area' filter.
semantic_search: Natural-language vector search over the framework (local embeddings). For fuzzy 'where/how do we…' questions grep can't answer.
search_code: Exact grep over .ts/.json/.md sources. Returns file:line matches.
read_file: Read a framework file (path relative to root), optional line range.
create_test_file: Write a new Playwright spec into tests/ (path must end .spec.ts). FIRST call list_page_objects + get_test_conventions; the spec MUST use real page-object methods and fixtures, never raw page.* calls.
write_architecture_doc: Generate + write a complete ARCHITECTURE.md (both Mermaid diagrams + tables) in one call. Prefer this over composing the doc yourself.
run_test: Run Playwright tests. Optional 'path' (a spec) or 'grep'. Returns the result summary.
